## Problem

On the dark and neo-dark board themes, card muted text (`--neo-board-card-muted-color`, used by `.neo-board-card-text` and `.neo-board-card-menu-button`) falls below WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 (4.5:1) against the card background:

- `theme-dark`: `#999` on resting `#3c3f41` = 3.72:1, on selected `#4f558a` = 2.46:1 (both fail)
- `theme-neo-dark`: `#8b97a8` on selected `#1e3346` = 4.38:1 (fails); 5.26:1 on resting passes

The other three shipped themes pass in both states. Contrast was verified with a WCAG relative-luminance script against the values resolved in `resources/css/theme-*/board/Container.css`.

Resolves #21783

## Root cause

The two dark themes hard-code muted colors chosen for their resting backgrounds without accounting for the selected card background, which lowers contrast below the 4.5:1 threshold; `theme-dark` additionally mapped the selected card background to `--grid-cellrowmodel-selected-row-cell-background-color` (`#4f558a`), a mid-lightness slate-purple that makes muted text unreadable there.

## Fix (per #21783 "The Fix", reworked from the first patch after an AC-1/AC-5 self-review)

- `theme-dark` (`resources/css/theme-dark/board/Container.css`): `--neo-board-card-selected-background` now points to the existing token `var(--grid-cell-value-band-1-background-color, #2d3e50)` (`theme-dark/grid/Container.css:5`, clearly distinct from resting `#3c3f41`), and `--neo-board-card-muted-color` to the existing token `var(--neo-color, #bbb)` (`theme-dark/Global.css:3`, already used by this file). No new colors invented (#20879 AC-5). Muted contrast: **5.53:1** resting / **5.71:1** selected; card title `#e0e0e0` keeps clear hierarchy (8.04:1 / 8.30:1).
- `theme-neo-dark` (`resources/css/theme-neo-dark/board/Container.css`): `--neo-board-card-muted-color` `#8b97a8` → `#9aa6b8`, matching the file's existing `--neo-board-badge-color` (`:21`). Muted contrast: **6.32:1** resting / **5.27:1** selected, still clearly secondary to `--neo-board-card-color: #e3e8f0` (10.55:1 on selected).
- The three already-passing themes are untouched.

The first patch on this PR (`#d2d2d2` / `#8f9bae` while keeping `#4f558a`) brightened muted text instead of reusing tokens — exactly what #21783's "Avoided Traps" rules out — so it was withdrawn and replaced with the prescribed token-based shape.

Note: PR #21782 is about #21649 (Scheduler/Gantt change origins) and does not touch board theme CSS.

## Testing

- WCAG relative-luminance script (`node`, run locally against the resolved theme values): before — `theme-dark` muted 3.72:1 resting / 2.46:1 selected and `theme-neo-dark` 4.38:1 selected (red, below 4.5:1); after — all four parseable themes pass on both resting and selected cards (`theme-dark` 5.53/5.71, `theme-neo-dark` 6.32/5.27, `theme-neo-light` 4.83/4.53, `theme-light` 5.74/4.53). `theme-cyberpunk` skipped: unchanged `color-mix()` values, already passing per the issue's measurements.
- `test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs`: added `coloredRest.mutedContrast >= 4.5` and `coloredSelected.mutedContrast >= 4.5` assertions for all five themes, and removed the temporary `if (neighbourUnhovered.mutedContrast >= 4.5)` guard so the `.neo-selected:hover` muted-text `>= 4.5:1` assertion now runs unconditionally (issue AC-2). The spec passes `node --check`; it was not run locally (this shallow rework clone has no `node_modules` and installing dependencies plus browser binaries exceeded the session budget) — the Playwright e2e suite runs on CI for this push.

## AC Evidence

- AC-1 (reuse existing tokens, per #20879 AC-5): `theme-dark` selected background points at the existing `--grid-cell-value-band-1-background-color` (declared at `theme-dark/grid/Container.css:5`) and muted at the existing `--neo-color` (`theme-dark/Global.css:3`); `theme-neo-dark` muted takes the file's existing `--neo-board-badge-color` value (`#9aa6b8`). No new color literals introduced.
- AC-2 (unconditional assertions): `MultiSelect.spec.mjs` asserts `mutedContrast >= 4.5` on resting and `.neo-selected` cards across all five themes; the temporary `neighbourUnhovered` guard is removed so the `.neo-selected:hover` case always runs.
- AC-3 (whole-page before/after 1440x900 frames of `examples/board/multiSelect` in `theme-dark` / `theme-neo-dark`): pending — the shallow rework clone has no `node_modules` and installing dependencies plus Playwright browser binaries exceeded the session budget, so the four frames are not attached; scoped screenshot assistance under the harness's assist path is requested in the reply below, and the frames will carry a `Frame critique:` line.
- AC-5 (no invented colors): covered by AC-1 — both replaced values point at tokens already shipped in the repo.

Evidence: WCAG 2.2 relative-luminance script over the resolved CSS values (numbers under `## Test Evidence`): before, `theme-dark` muted 3.72:1 resting / 2.46:1 selected and `theme-neo-dark` 4.38:1 selected — all red; after, every parseable theme passes both card states.

## Deltas from ticket

- None from the ticket's final prescription: both `theme-dark` values reuse exactly the tokens named in #21783's "The Fix", `theme-neo-dark` muted takes the badge color, and the spec asserts >= 4.5 in both card states. The one deviation is already superseded: the withdrawn first patch brightened muted text over the old selected background instead of re-pointing the selected-background token; it was replaced after an AC-1/AC-5 self-review.

## Test Evidence

- WCAG relative-luminance script (`node`, run locally against the resolved theme values): before — `theme-dark` muted 3.72:1 resting / 2.46:1 selected, `theme-neo-dark` 4.38:1 selected (red, below 4.5:1); after — all four parseable themes pass on both resting and selected cards (`theme-dark` 5.53/5.71, `theme-neo-dark` 6.32/5.27, `theme-neo-light` 4.83/4.53, `theme-light` 5.74/4.53). `theme-cyberpunk` skipped: unchanged `color-mix()` values, already passing per the issue's measurements.
- `MultiSelect.spec.mjs` passes `node --check`; the Playwright board suite executes on CI for this PR (e2e-engine shards).
- Local `npm ci` plus browser install exceeded this session's budget on the shallow clone, so the spec was not executed locally — declared here rather than left implicit.

## Post-Merge Validation

- On the live `examples/board/multiSelect` page in `theme-dark` and `theme-neo-dark`, confirm muted card text and the card menu button stay readable on both resting and selected cards (the values are static tokens, so a spot check per theme suffices).
- The merged CI keeps holding the line: the board `MultiSelect` spec now fails on any theme whose muted text drops below 4.5:1 in either card state.

Captured by reviewer per `rendered-surface-audit.md` item 1 (`dev` vs detached `8d02533c6576d2b491d9b587716ac9ba6034c7a4` after `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`):

![after-theme-dark](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/julia/21783-evidence/after-theme-dark.png?raw=true)

**Frame critique:** Whole `1440×900` viewport captured for both themes with cards `1042`–`1044` selected alongside resting Inbox cards (`1041`, `1045`–`1049`) and the three empty target columns (`This sprint`, `Later`, `Won't fix`). In `theme-dark`, replacing `#4f558a` with `#2d3e50` eliminates the washed-out purple fill on selected cards and on the `3 selected` pill, harmonizes with the `#64b5f6` selection ring, and makes the `···` menu button, toolbar subtitle, shortcut legend, and `Drop reports here` placeholders clearly readable (`5.53:1`–`7.38:1`) while `#e0e0e0` card titles remain dominant (`8.04:1` / `8.30:1`). In `theme-neo-dark`, lifting `--neo-board-card-muted-color` from `#8b97a8` to `#9aa6b8` brings selected-card `···` menu buttons over `4.5:1` (`5.27:1`) without competing with `#e3e8f0` titles (`10.55:1`). No visual defects observed.
